display_long_description:
Coloris transforms your room into a peaceful mixed‑reality puzzle space where your hands do all the work. ✋🌈
Put your controllers aside and dive into a relaxing world of color‑matching challenges designed around smooth, intuitive hand‑tracking interactions. Solve gradients, align hues, and snap pieces into place with gestures that feel natural, precise, and deeply satisfying.
Built for comfort and clarity, Coloris blends seamlessly into your environment, creating a cozy MR experience that’s perfect for unwinding, focusing, or taking a creative break. Every puzzle is handcrafted to feel calming yet rewarding, offering a gentle flow state that players of all ages can enjoy.
✨ Features
• 	Hand‑Tracking Only -> Play entirely with your hands. No controllers needed.
• 	Mixed Reality Gameplay -> Puzzles appear naturally in your real space.
• 	Relaxing Color Challenges -> Match hues, gradients, and patterns in a soothing flow.
• 	Tactile Interactions -> Grab, rotate, and snap pieces with responsive precision.
• 	Cozy & Accessible -> Easy to learn, calming to play, and welcoming for everyone.
• 	Replayable & Creative -> Each puzzle feels fresh, inviting experimentation and exploration.
Whether you're a puzzle fan, a hand‑tracking enthusiast, or someone looking for a calm MR experience, Coloris offers a warm, tactile escape that fits beautifully into your everyday space. 🎨
